items.title: The Architecture of Truth: How Siemens' AI-Powered Executable Digital Twin is Rewriting the Rules of Industrial Intelligence
items.excerpt: Siemens describes an Executable Digital Twin architecture that compresses multiphysics models with reduced-order modeling and AI for real-time operational use, combining physics-based state estimation with live plant data, agents and knowledge graphs.

items.title: Why Agentic AI Could Redefine the Future of Design and Verification
items.excerpt: Siemens EDA argues that agentic AI may shift engineers from operating individual verification tools toward orchestrating integrated, exploratory workflows; the post frames a future 'Design & Verification Scientist' role rather than announcing a new product.
items.query: Siemens EDA agentic AI design verification August 2026

items.title: Accelerate antenna design optimization with Simcenter Feko and Simcenter HEEDS
items.excerpt: Siemens demonstrates an automated Feko–HEEDS workflow for an 11-variable antenna lens design using high-fidelity EM simulation and multi-objective optimization over more than 150 designs; the highlighted solution improved gain by 22% and a roundness KPI by 59%.

items.title: Virtual Integrated Aircraft: A methodology for early aircraft systems integration with Simcenter systems simulation
items.excerpt: Siemens presents Virtual Integrated Aircraft as a structured systems-engineering method combining MBSE, multidomain simulation, verification workflows and digital-thread continuity to integrate propulsion, fuel, thermal, electrical and control systems early in aircraft development.

items.title: Turn 3D Scans Into Editable CAD Models in Autodesk Fusion with the New Backflip AI Add-In
items.excerpt: Autodesk says the new Backflip AI add-in converts 3D scans and mesh files into editable parametric Fusion models with feature history, bringing AI-assisted scan-to-CAD reconstruction into the same environment used for design, validation and manufacturing.
